description: Use this when someone asks what a mining company's newest drill holes mean: where they sit, how they compare with the company's other holes, or whether they hit the company's targets. Give it the company's ticker or name. Returns the company's 3D model as its 6ix.com page shows it: hole and metre counts, each recent hole's interval with the most grade × metres and its rank among every hole in its deposit, whether it hit, extended or missed each target the company published (with the company's expected grade and width), the company's own words about each target, and the cautionary statement that applies to exploration targets. Only companies that chose to show their model have one.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

name: get_drill_model
title: 3D drill model
